UPSTREAM: drm/amd/amdgpu: Added a quirk for Stoney platform Added DW_I2S_QUIRK_16BIT_IDX_OVERRIDE quirk for Stoney. Supported format and bus width for I2S controller read from I2S Component Parameter registers. These are ready only registers. For Stoney, I2S Component Parameter registers are programmed to support 32 bit format and 4 bytes bus width only. By setting this quirk,It will override 32 bit format with 16 bit format and 2 bytes as bus width for Stoney. CHROMIUM: MALI: Avoid waiting forever in kbase_jm_wait_for_zero_jobs() It appears that kbase_jm_wait_for_zero_jobs() was re-inventing wait_event_timeout(). This added a bunch of unneeded complexity was also the source of a few bugs. Specifically: 1. Even after the timeout the old code kept waiting on the two conditions to become true. The old code would have done that since the old timeout callback did nothing to cause the old wait_event() functions to stop waiting (it's been validated that calling kbase_reset_gpu() wasn't enough to cause "job_nr" to become 0). 2. Even if KBASE_GPU_RESET_EN was not defined the old code still pretended that the reset happened and still waited on reset_wait. Let's use wait_event_timeout() and fix the bugs. BUG=b:64852540 TEST=Build and boot Change-Id: I7c828a72cb9e7214aa6b0ebf218aba8913326a41 Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/642133 Reviewed-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: John Einar Reitan <john.reitan@arm.com> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>

config_utils: Remove the sepcial field "inherit" from resolved config. The field "inherit" on the top-level of the JSON config dictionary is reserved for listing dependent configs. This CL modifies `config_utils.LoadConfig` so that it removes this special field before doing the schema check. As the result, the json schema of the config no longer need to define the format of "inherit" field.
